title: Opportunity Radar
summary: YTIntel can now find and rank the competitor research set for you instead of making you manually hunt videos one by one.
discord_changes: Discovers niche videos and verifies channel-relative breakouts automatically.
Ranks opportunities using velocity, recency, outlier strength and replay evidence.
Builds a cross-channel research set you can send straight into Pattern Mine.
changes: Added a new top-level Opportunity Radar tab for automatic niche and topic discovery.
Added channel-relative verification across the strongest candidate creators so raw view count is not mistaken for an outlier.
Added age-adjusted view velocity and recency ranking so emerging videos can outrank stale high-view uploads.
Added cross-channel title-concept clustering with winner-heavy, cross-channel and control-heavy classifications.
Added an Opportunity Score with explicit confidence limits when channel baseline data is unavailable.
Added automatic channel-diverse research-set selection and one-click handoff of 5–10 videos into Pattern Mine.
Added browser-local Radar history so previous opportunity maps can be restored without another discovery pass.
Fixed live version-status drift so the GPT-5.6 Sol health checker now respects the current YTIntel release version.
Refreshed the PWA cache so installed copies receive v0.12.0 automatically.
why_it_matters: YTIntel now covers the step before analysis: finding what is worth analysing. That closes the loop from discovery to verification to deep analysis to cross-video Pattern Mine, while keeping channel baselines and replication checks between raw popularity and a production decision.
